findings.message: scenario mariadb_audit__holdout_02: the detection rule expected 4 matches but found 0. the documents carry event.action but never host.hostname. Those fields are declared in the mapping and absent from the output, so either the source key does not exist or the extraction is not reaching it.
the probe injected 'b2558312fb0c' as host.hostname, but the parser put it in observer.hostname. Whatever the source calls that key, its value is host.hostname - that is what the probe did.
the probe injected '172.21.0.3' as source.ip, but the parser put it in client.ip. Whatever the source calls that key, its value is source.ip - that is what the probe did.
the probe injected 'root' as user.name, but the parser put it in client.user.name. Whatever the source calls that key, its value is user.name - that is what the probe did.
